title: The FR-035 `semantic` block, extracted
description: The `semantic` sub-schema of the filament-core-service FR-035 module-manifest schema (quoin FR-070). It is extracted rather than vendored whole because NO single published copy of that schema covers both this module's keys and the semantic block: the copy `spec-artifacts-iso` ships (the pinned dependency, and the authority for `traceability` and `verification_catalog`) predates `semantic` and rejects it under `additionalProperties: false`, while the copy carrying `semantic` does not know `traceability` or `verification_catalog` at all. Filed as agent-ix/filament-core-service#27. Until one revision covers both, the manifest is checked against the shipped schema with `semantic` removed, and the block itself is checked here.
